# Jeremiah 30 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-word which came to Jeremiah from-YHWH, saying:

**2** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**3** "For behold, days are-coming," declares YHWH, "and-I-will-restore the-fortunes-of My-people Israel and-Judah," says YHWH, "and-I-will-bring-them-back to the-land which I-gave to-their-fathers, and-they-will-possess-it."

**4** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**5** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**6** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**7** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**8** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**9** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**10** "And-you, do-not-fear, My-servant Jacob," declares YHWH, "and-do-not-be-dismayed, Israel, for behold-Me saving-you from-afar, and-your-seed from-the-land-of their-captivity; and-Jacob will-return and-be-quiet and-at-ease, and-none will-make-[him]-afraid.

**11** For with-you I [am]," declares YHWH, "to-save-you; for I-will-make a-full-end of-all the-nations where I-scattered-you, but-of-you I-will-not make a-full-end; and-I-will-discipline-you with-justice, but-I-will-certainly-not leave-you-unpunished."

**12** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**13** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**14** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**15** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**16** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**17** "For I-will-bring-up healing for-you, and-from-your-wounds I-will-heal-you," declares YHWH, "for 'Outcast' they-called-you: 'Zion — no-one seeks-her.'"

**18** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**19** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**20** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**21** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**22** "And-you-will-be to-Me for-a-people, and-I will-be to-you for-God."

**23** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**24** And-YHWH declared concerning restoration promises through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **30:1**: Opening formula for the restoration promises oracle. Prophetic messenger formula with historical setting.

- **30:12**: Central imagery of healed wounds — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic discourse on judgment and restoration.

- **30:24**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The prophetic oracle is sealed by divine authority.

— EMET
